_comment: English names of external laws/ordinances cited FROM any feed, keyed by the exact external_name string a ref resolves to. Shared across all feeds since the same law is cited from many regulations. This is name resolution ONLY — per-citation content summaries live on the ref itself (external_item_summary_*), not here, since 'what does this law say' isn't useful at law-level granularity: it needs to be pinned to the exact article/paragraph/item cited.
